title: Personality and Persuasion
coverage: opening + one cue-ranked passage + headings; partial inspection

passages.text: Last weekend, ChatGPT suddenly became my biggest fan — and not just mine, but everyone's.

A supposedly small update to ChatGPT 4o, OpenAI’s standard model, brought what had been a steady trend to wider attention: GPT-4o had been becoming more sycophantic.
